components.name: Inline Link
components.description: The only interactive primitive in the system. Plain ink text, underline appears only on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #1b1b18; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1b1b18; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Article List Row
components.description: One row in the homepage feed (articles and photo projects merged, reverse-chron) or the Writing index. Title link plus an inline whisper-gray secondary line: a plain-text type tag (homepage only) and, middot-separated, an excerpt or photo count.

components.name: Photo Grid Tile
components.description: One tile in a project's photo grid (/photos/{slug}): full-bleed cropped image, optional whisper-gray caption that brightens to ink on hover, opens the photo in the in-page Lightbox on click.

components.name: Project Card
components.description: One card in the Photos index (/photos): cover image, title that underlines on hover, and a whisper-gray photo count below it. Links to the project's own page.

components.name: Lightbox
components.description: Full-screen exhibition overlay opened by clicking a Photo Grid Tile. The one signature, theme-independent surface in the system — always dark regardless of light/dark mode. Centered contained image, caption in full contrast (not whisper), N/total counter, text-only Prev/Next controls, Close button. Escape, backdrop click, or Close all dismiss it. 200ms opacity fade, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.css: .ds-lightbox { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(10,10,10,0.95); padding: 24px; } .ds-lightbox-close { position: absolute; top: 24px; right: 24px; font-size: 14px; color: #8a8a86; background: none; border: none; } .ds-lightbox-close:hover, .ds-lightbox-close:focus-visible { color: #EDEDEC; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-lightbox-img { max-height: 78vh; max-width: 90vw; object-fit: contain; } .ds-lightbox-caption { margin-top: 16px; max-width: 64ch; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; color: #EDEDEC; } .ds-lightbox-counter { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: #8a8a86; } .ds-lightbox-nav { margin-top: 24px; display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-lightbox-btn { font-size: 14px; color: #8a8a86; background: none; border: none; } .ds-lightbox-btn:hover, .ds-lightbox-btn:focus-visible { color: #EDEDEC; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Site Nav
components.description: The single reusable navigation partial (partials/site-nav.blade.php), included at the top of every page, Home included. Five plain inline links separated by a whisper-gray middot — no box, no border, no sticky position, scrolls away with the page like any other text line.

narrative.overview: Plain text on plain ground; the words are the only thing performing. There is no navbar, no card, no button styling, no icon system — a page is a max-width column of text with generous top-of-viewport air (12vh–20vh vertical padding) and a handful of underlined inline links. The system exists to disappear: nothing here should read as "designed" in the sense of decorated. Confirmed rejections: no serif display face (an earlier design pass explored Georgia/slab serif treatments — the shipped system is plain Instrument Sans throughout, sans-serif only), no accent color, no chrome of any kind (no header bar, no card borders, no button backgrounds).
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Instrument Sans) at five sizes, no serif, no display face
Two-color palette per theme (ink/paper) plus one whisper gray for secondary text
Zero elevation, zero radius — completely flat
Layout is a single centered column; width and vertical rhythm carry all the hierarchy
Links are the only interactive affordance: plain text, underline only on hover/focus

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: There is no accent color anywhere in the system. Every visual distinction is made with size, weight positioning, or the whisper-gray recession — never with hue. The sole exception is the Lightbox's scrim, which opts out of the light/dark pairing entirely for one isolated surface rather than adding a hue.

rules.name: The No-Weight Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the site is bold. Hierarchy comes from size and color (ink vs. whisper) only.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: No shadows, no radius, no borders, ever. If a future component seems to need depth to read correctly, the fix is spacing or type weight, not a shadow.

rules.name: The One Partial Rule
rules.body: Site-wide navigation lives in exactly one file (partials/site-nav.blade.php), included by reference everywhere it's needed. If a page needs a different link set, that's an information-architecture change, not a reason to fork the partial.

rules.name: The One Shell Rule
rules.body: Every page uses the same 900px outer container. A page may narrow its own content further for reading measure (max-w-64ch) but the shell itself is never resized per page.

dos: Do keep every new page inside the single 900px shell — never introduce a page-specific outer width.
Do use whisper gray (#8a8a86) for any secondary/metadata text (dates, captions, counts) — never for primary content or links.
Do use hover:underline hover:underline-offset-4 as the only interactive-state treatment for links.
Do use viewport-relative vertical padding (vh units) for page-level rhythm rather than fixed px page margins.
donts: Don't add a shadow, border, or border-radius anywhere — The Flat Ground Rule is absolute.
Don't introduce a second typeface, a bold weight, or an accent color — The One Ink Rule and The No-Weight Rule are absolute.
Don't add card containers, chips, badges, or icon systems — the system has no container components at all, only text and images.
Don't add a persistent header/nav bar without deciding explicitly that The Quiet Page's no-chrome stance is being revised — it isn't a gap to silently fill.
Don't give a page its own outer container width — The One Shell Rule is absolute; narrow an inner reading column instead.
